$comment: NPC ids the cache retired (no name, no options) and the NPC that replaced each one in the same place, matched by identical models and confirmed in rev 242 captures where the area was visited. Until the transcripts are regenerated for the new NPCs, a successor that has no transcript of its own plays its predecessor's (NpcDialogues). Retired ids with no successor (Ranged, Magic, Cooking, Prayer and Banker tutors) are not listed. The cache of 2026-11-11 gave the retired ids to other NPCs (3216-3227, 5523, 8665 and 16475-16477: Farmer Bea, the Bee dealer, the wasp swarms and honey buzzards of Birds and the Wasps). npc-dialogue-index.json and npc-examines.json still hold the retired NPCs' entries under these ids: `reassigned` lists them, and NpcDialogues reads such an entry only for a successor (below), never for the NPC that now has the id; the new NPCs' examines are in npc-examine-overrides.json.
